## Set-up
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(arcgis)
library(mapview)
library(janitor)
```

## Read in Priority Natural Communities Core
Data accessed from [BioMap Feature Layer](https://wellesley.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=d5f44922e5e446b3a3bd0a32dd04a498#overview)
```{r}
furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/1"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
pncc <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "pncc")


furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/2"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
aqua_core <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "aqua_core")

furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/3"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
wetland <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "wetland")

furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/4"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
rare_species <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "rare_species")

furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/5"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
forest <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "forest")

furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/BioMap_CoreHabitatComponents/FeatureServer/6"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)
vernal_pool <- arc_select(flayer) |> clean_names() |> mutate(layer = "vernal_pool")
```

Join rows and fix geometries. Note that there are some pretty cool columns, 
specifically in the pncc, rare_species, and aqua_core datasets that I needed to 
drop to maintain consistent dat structure, but may be work looking into! You can 
read more about metadata [here](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massgis-data-biomap-the-future-of-conservation)
```{r}

biomap_core_hab <- pncc |> select(layer) |> 
  bind_rows(aqua_core)|> select(layer) |> 
   bind_rows(wetland)|> select(layer) |> 
   bind_rows(rare_species)|> select(layer) |> 
   bind_rows(forest)|> select(layer) |>
   bind_rows(vernal_pool)|> select(layer) |> 
  mutate(id = 1:18761) |> 
  st_make_valid()

```

## Read in DCR Ecoregions
Data accessed from [MA DCR Feature Layer](https://wellesley.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=bce82aad47394bf7a3add219f3c92297#overview)
```{r}
furl <- "https://wellesley.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=bce82aad47394bf7a3add219f3c92297"
flayer <- arc_open(furl)

layer <- get_layer(flayer, 0)
ecoregions <- arc_select(layer)

# set CRS to match biomap data 
ecoregions <- ecoregions |> st_transform(st_crs(biomap_core_hab)) |> st_make_valid() |> 
  clean_names() |> select(econame)
```

# Calculate percent of Biomap Core Habitat per Ecoregion
```{r}
# total area
total_bio_area <- biomap_core_hab |>
  mutate(area = st_area(geometry)) |>
  pull(area) |>
  sum()

# prop area by ecoregion
bio_by_eco <- st_intersection(biomap_core_hab, ecoregions) |>
  mutate(area = st_area(geometry)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(econame) |>
  summarise(area = sum(area)) |>
  mutate(perc_of_bio_area = (area / total_bio_area)*100)

## data distribution 
summary(bio_by_eco)
## cut data 
bio_by_eco <- bio_by_eco  |>
  mutate(perc_bio_cat = cut(perc_of_bio_area,
    breaks = c(1, 3.8, 6.6, 9.4, 23),
    labels = c("1-3.8%", "3.8-6.6%", "6.6-9.5%", "9.5-23%")))

bio_by_eco <- ecoregions |> left_join(bio_by_eco)

## map
bio_by_eco |>
  ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(aes(fill = perc_bio_cat)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(c("#DD5A54", "#EDBFB2", "#EC940C", "#608ED8")))
  
```
Note-- can likely afford to add correct font, remove background, and add legend 
and north arrow.
